seen_animation: A single-line doodled basket (a wide rim ellipse, a tapered bowl, one arched handle) stands in front of grey scenery: a tree, a cactus-like plant, two small baskets and two tables. In frames 1-4 the handle is a narrow upright loop seen edge-on, and the basket sits in the lower middle. Over frames 5-8 the basket grows larger and the handle opens into a wider arch. In frames 9-14 the handle is a full broad arch, the basket is at its largest, it drifts left, and its bottom runs off the lower edge of the frame. In frames 15-16 the handle narrows back to an edge-on loop that leans to the right in frame 16, and the basket moves back toward the centre.
seen_film: A hand holds a woven basket by its double-strand handle and turns it slowly in front of seated basket weavers. In frames 1-4 the handle faces the camera edge-on, so it looks narrow, and the basket hangs in the upper middle. In frames 5-8 the basket comes closer and lower, and the handle starts to open. In frames 9-14 the basket is turned so the handle shows as a broad arch; the basket fills most of the frame, sits left of centre, and its bottom is cut off by the lower edge. In frames 15-16 it turns back so the handle is edge-on again, leaning slightly, and the basket moves right.
named_subject: A woven basket with an arched handle, held and rotated so the handle turns from edge-on to broadside and back.
evidence: Still frames only, no playback seen. In e.png frames 1-16 the handle stays a narrow loop and the basket grows slowly, matching f.png 1-16 where the handle is edge-on. Frames 17-24 widen the handle step by step (17 narrow arch, 21 medium, 24 wide) while f.png 17-24 shows the handle opening at the same rate. Frames 25-44 hold a broad arch, the basket drifts left and its bottom is cropped from about frame 31 on, matching f.png 25-44 where the basket is broadside, left of centre and cut off at the bottom. Frames 45-50 narrow the handle back to an edge-on loop that leans right in 49-50, matching f.png 45-50. g.png shows the handle centres travelling in one continuous path with no reversals that the film lacks. The steepest single change is 48 to 49, where the handle narrows quickly, but f.png 48 to 49 shows the same quick narrowing.
primary_gap: The handle narrows from a medium arch in e.png frame 48 to a thin loop in frame 49 in one step, which is the largest per-frame change in the shot and may read as a small pop in playback.
closes_when: The handle width in frames 46-49 decreases in roughly equal steps so that frame 49 is only slightly narrower than frame 48.
protect: The doodle's construction (open rim ellipse with overlapping stroke ends at the left, angular tapered bowl, single-stroke arched handle with unequal legs); the gradual handle rotation from edge-on to broadside and back timed to the film; the growth in size and leftward drift with bottom cropping in frames 25-44; the stable grey scenery.
identity_gap: The basket keeps the doodle's open rim, angular bowl and single-line handle throughout, though when the handle is edge-on it becomes a thin two-line loop that the doodle never shows, which is a necessary consequence of the rotation.
